topography.project_purpose: Staking Pool. Structurally: 7 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 1 ERC20 token; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 4 functional families. Its contracts share 1 common project-authored base contract(s) (baseupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
